mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, PROFILE_IMG, PROVIDER, CHEER_COUNT, USER_LEVEL, INTERESTS, IS_PUBLIC, STREAK_COUNT FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, INTERESTS, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID ) VALUES ( RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID()), #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{interests}, #{provider}, #{providerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, PROFILE_IMG, PROVIDER, CHEER_COUNT, USER_LEVEL, INTERESTS, IS_PUBLIC, STREAK_COUNT FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND PASSWORD = #{password}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHEER ( CHEER_ID, REQUEST_USER_ID, RESPONSE_USER_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CHEER.NEXTVAL, #{requestUserId}, #{responseUserId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET CHEER_COUNT = CHEER_COUNT - 1 WHERE USER_ID = #{value} AND CHEER_COUNT > 0
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS "userId", EMAIL AS "email", PASSWORD AS "password", NICKNAME AS "nickname", PROFILE_IMG AS "profileImg", PROVIDER AS "provider", CHEER_COUNT AS "cheerCount", USER_LEVEL AS "userLevel", INTERESTS AS "interests", IS_PUBLIC AS "isPublic", STREAK_COUNT AS "streakCount" FROM USERS WHERE PROVIDER = #{provider} AND PROVIDER_ID = #{providerId}
